task.description:
WF-03 Step 3: Implement Memory Leak Fix for ISS-0601-LEAK-001

Issue: Memory leak in src/definition/store.zig parseGraphJson - node IDs allocated without free.

Design approved: src/design/definition-leak-fix.md

Implementation tasks:
1. Add Definition.deinit(allocator) method to src/definition/graph.zig
2. Add DefinitionGraph.deinit(allocator) method to src/definition/graph.zig
3. Update freeDefinition() and freeDefinitionGraph() to delegate to new deinit methods
4. Add defer def.deinit(allocator) to the 9 confirmed leaking call sites listed in the design:
   - tests/integration/iss601_state_snapshots_test.zig (5 sites)
   - src/api/routes/definitions.zig (4 sites)
5. Run error-set validation: zig build 2>&1 | grep -i error set (must be empty)
6. Run: zig build
7. Run: zig build test
8. Run: BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test zig build test-integration-iss601
   Expected: 9/9 PASS or 8/9 with TC-09 skip (zero leaks)

Acceptance criteria from GitHub #406:
- src/definition/store.zig no longer leaks parseGraphJson allocations
- tests/integration/iss601_state_snapshots_test.zig reaches 9/9 PASS (or 8/9 with TC-09 skip)
- No regression in other integration tests

Commit implementation to feature/WF03-gh406-20260803 before completing.

Return PASS only when all acceptance criteria met and committed.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test-integration-iss601 shows 9/9 PASS (or 8/9) with zero leak reports
